facts.description:
Discover W Residences Singapore - Marina View, in the heart of Marina Bay, Singapore's new downtown and where it's all at.
Embrace liberated luxury with sleek, chic apartments that offer exclusive 5-star W facilities and services. 
With the vibrant W Hotel at your doorstep, you gain access to world-class amenities and a level of attention you've only dreamt of.
The energy of Asia's hottest cosmopolitan city, the excitement of an "always on" lifestyle district, and the inimitable style of the W Residences Singapore - Marina View. Make every day anything but ordinary.
